english_elaboration_excerpt: The name Surabhaye (Surabhi, in the nominative case) is rich with multiple layers of meaning, encompassing fragrance, charm, celestial entities, and abundance, all attributed to Kalabhairava.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who is cool and refreshing like the winter season, the very soul of coolness.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who is the beautiful, sacred branch or the well-established peak.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who is worthy of being worshipped by all the divine gods.
english_elaboration_excerpt: The name Surārādhyāya is a compound of Surā and Ārādhyāya, denoting a profound reverence and supreme position in the cosmic hierarchy.

english_elaboration_excerpt: The name Sumatā (Sumatāya) is a compound of the Sanskrit terms Su and Matā (or Mati).

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who is the precious and radiant metal, gold.
english_elaboration_excerpt: The name Svarṇāya (Svarna) literally translates to "gold" or "golden." In the context of Kalabhairava, this seemingly simple term carries profound spiritual, philosophical, and alchemical significance.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who is the lord of heaven (Svarga).
english_elaboration_excerpt: The name Svarmīne is derived from the Sanskrit words Svar and Mīne, which can be interpreted as variations or aspects of the concept of Svar-pati or Svar-īśa.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who churns the celestial ocean of musical notes.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who is the divine, resonant sound.
english_elaboration_excerpt: The name Svanāya, derived from the Sanskrit root “svan,” refers to sound, resonance, and echo. It represents Kalabhairava as the embodiment of subtle, divine sound and the primal vibration that underlies all existence.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who is the supreme and ultimate goal for all truthful and virtuous beings.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who is always victorious and ever-triumphant.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who is the divine, swift horse, or the number seven.
english_elaboration_excerpt: The name Saptaye is rich in symbolism, drawing from the Sanskrit root "Sapta," meaning "seven," and also alluding to the swiftness of horses.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who possesses a calm, serene, and peaceful intellect.

english_one_line: Salutations To The one who has a perfectly pure and untainted intellect.
english_elaboration_excerpt: The name Śuddhabuddhāya is a profound descriptor of Kalabhairava, formed from the Sanskrit words "Śuddha" (pure, clean, untainted) and "Buddhi" (intellect, understanding, reason, perception).
